wall.source: p.568 Sec.2; Fig.4 (400 mm thickness); Fig.6 (6000 x 2500)

reinforcement.value: two faces of vertical bars with horizontal ties/links, continuing into a reinforced strip footing; no bar sizes, spacing, cover or steel grade given

concrete_strength.value: not stated for the test wall; numerical model uses AUTODYN library material labelled CONC-35MPa (RHT)

footing.value: inverted-T: wall stem continues below grade into a wider reinforced strip footing on a lean base layer; no dimensions given; i.e. cantilever from a buried footing

flanking.value: no wing walls; sandbag piles are stacked against both wall ends in the photos

ground.value: natural soil/earth at the site (photos); flush-mounted ground gauges; model uses sand (compaction EOS, MO granular)

tests.source: p.568 Sec.2; p.569 Fig.7 caption; Fig.4

free_field_reference_note.value: No test without the wall. The 'free field' p-gauges were in the same two shots, on the blast side. The with/without-wall ratios divide behind-wall measurements by an empirical ground-burst formula (Eq.7, GB 6722-2014), not by a measured free-field value.
free_field_reference_note.source: p.569 Fig.7 caption; p.574 Sec.4.3.2 Eq.7

results_incident.source: p.572 text; Fig.15b; Table 1 gives CONWEP 1.10

results_incident.note: test waveform still positive at 10 ms window end (~0.0)

results_reflected.note: test trace is a narrow oscillating spike, second peak ~2.8 MPa; quasi-decay ~1 MPa at 2.5 ms

results_behind_wall.note: filtered 2000 Hz; positive phase continues past 16 ms window
printed free-field 122.4 kPa is a typo: Eq.7 at 7.4 m for 20 kg gives ~167 kPa, which matches Fig.20 curve and eta 0.33; text 54.5 vs Table 4 52.1

arrival_time_caveat.value: time origin of plotted traces is not stated; CONWEP curves appear aligned to test arrival in Figs.12, 16

wall_response.value: after the 20 kg shot the front face is intact with no obvious concrete damage; no deflection, strain or acceleration measured

numerical_model.code: ANSYS AUTODYN (not LS-DYNA), 2D axisymmetric, multi-material Euler with fluid-structure interaction; wall becomes an annular ring (side diffraction lost)
numerical_model.domain: about 23 m by 10 m, soil layer about 2 m deep, outflow boundaries except axis
numerical_model.materials: air ideal gas (1.225 kg/m3, gamma 1.4, e0 2.068e5 kJ/kg as printed); TNT JWL (A 3.7377e5 MPa, B 3.7471e3 MPa, R1 4.15, R2 0.9, omega 0.35, E 6.0e3 MJ/m3); sand compaction EOS + MO granular (2641 kg/m3); concrete P-alpha EOS + RHT, CONC-35MPa; rebar smeared by raising tensile strength to 6.0 MPa
numerical_model.comparison: incident peaks close to CONWEP beyond 5 m; reflected peak 5 kg underpredicted (1.66 vs 3.24 MPa), 20 kg over (8.69 vs 7.72); behind-wall peaks 17/15 vs 14/11-12 kPa (5 kg) and 38 vs 52-55 kPa (20 kg). 2D vs 3D eta differ: 3D 0.12-0.37 vs 2D 0.10-0.40 for 5 kg (Fig.8)
numerical_model.parametric_fit: Eq.13: eta = 0.24 (d/W^1/3)^-1.01 (h/d)^-0.81 (r/W^1/3)^0.63, R2 0.87, r <= 20 m, h <= 4.5 m; inputs per Table 2 (d 2-6 m, W 10-200 kg, h 2.5-4.5 m); Eqs.10-12 per standoff band; Eq.13 vs Xu gabion tests errors 10-52% (Table 3)
